faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Sperling-Duthie?

faq.q: Is Sperling-Duthie a buyers’ or sellers’ market?

The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.
